findings.summary: Image focal areas cannot be created or resized using the keyboard.
findings.fix: Expose labelled coordinate and size inputs or implement a focusable crop widget with keyboard create, move and resize actions; keep hidden model fields synchronized and provide a single-pointer alternative to dragging.
findings.evidence: At /admin/images/51/, focus .jcrop-keymgr and press ArrowRight, ArrowDown, Space, Enter: all four hidden coordinates remain empty, selection w/h remain 0. Jcrop keyboard handler only moves an existing rectangle; no resize/create keys.

findings.summary: The focal-point chooser receives keyboard focus in an offscreen radio input with no visible focus indicator.
findings.fix: Provide a visible, focusable focal-area control and draw an obvious focus indicator on the displayed image/widget when keyboard focus enters.
findings.evidence: Runtime .jcrop-keymgr is type=radio with position:fixed;left:-120px;width:12px. Keyboard focus stays on this offscreen input after arrow keys and there is no visible selection for images without a focal area.

passed: Dashboard first Tab reaches visible skip link; Enter transfers focus to #main.
StreamField and InlinePanel provide native up/down buttons as alternatives to sorting by drag.
OrderableController provides ArrowUp/ArrowDown reordering and explicitly restores handle focus.
KeyboardController respects user setting disabling shortcuts.
Image URL preview scroll container is reached by Tab in Chromium 152 through implicit scroll-container focusability; axe missing-tabindex result is not a confirmed Chromium keyboard failure.
notes: Runtime tests used isolated Chromium and real Tab/Enter/Escape key events; no persisted writes.
Archive cannot validate successful uploads, server validation redirects or successful saves. Full screen-reader behaviour and Firefox/Safari scroll-container behaviour remain untested.

Focus restoration improvement: StreamField/InlinePanel deletion and Escape from dropdown/sidebar leave activeElement BODY, but subsequent Tab resumes logically (Insert block, Add author, listing Search and following Help trigger respectively); not recorded as confirmed 2.4.3 failures.
